metadata.title: Synthetic Invoice Copies and Fields FAQ

content:
# Local synthetic invoice FAQ

This is an invented, customer-facing knowledge source for the local support demo only. It does not describe a real product and must not be used for real customer requests.

## Invoice copies

Only workspace owners and billing admins can download issued invoices for a workspace they are authorized to access. Regular workspace members cannot download invoices.

To download an issued invoice, sign in, open Billing > Invoices, select the invoice, and choose Download PDF.

This FAQ documents PDF downloads only; it does not specify CSV export or automatic emailing.

## Invoice fields

An invoice number identifies the invoice document; it is not an account number or proof that payment has been completed.

The billing period is the date range covered by the invoice's charges; it is not the payment-due date.

The currency field identifies the denomination of the invoice amounts; it does not provide an exchange rate.

## Copilot boundary

This local copilot can explain these FAQs. It does not retrieve or send private invoices, grant permissions, change billing details, cancel subscriptions, or process refunds.
